question: What client protocol does B2DROP expose: is the sync/calendar/address-book client access documented as WebDAV/CalDAV/CardDAV on a first-party B2DROP page?
why: The first-party FAQ documents sync/calendar/address-book clients with an app password but does not name the protocol; webdav was used as the nearest interface term and the true wording is in interface_detail.
